subject.title: Feature: allow account switching from /models buttons for GPT and Claude

question: Should `/models` grow a first-class cross-channel account/auth-profile selector for provider-backed models, and what shared picker contract should Discord, Telegram, Mattermost, and future channel pickers implement?
rationale: The low-level auth-profile override path exists, but the UX, compatibility semantics, provider/profile compatibility filtering, and cross-channel callback contract are product and upgrade-policy decisions.

options.title: Define Shared Picker Contract
options.body: Add a shared account/profile picker model consumed by supported channel pickers, including compatible profile lists, active-profile display, and tests for typed `/model ...@profile` parity.

options.title: Keep Typed Commands Only
options.body: Decide that `/model ...@profile`, `/model status`, and CLI auth-order flows remain the supported account-switching path and close or defer picker UX work.

options.title: Pilot One Channel First
options.body: Approve a narrower experiment in one channel while explicitly documenting that other picker surfaces stay unchanged until a shared contract is accepted.

recommendation.title: Define Shared Picker Contract
recommendation.body: Add a shared account/profile picker model consumed by supported channel pickers, including compatible profile lists, active-profile display, and tests for typed `/model ...@profile` parity.

likelyOwner.reason: The newest current-main ownership across the shared picker/session surfaces points to vincentkoc, with steipete as an adjacent auth/session reviewer candidate.
